$comment: Generated by driving https://utopia.fyi/ in a real browser. These parameters are the SOURCE OF TRUTH for every clamp() in fluid-type.css and fluid-space.css. The structural gate recomputes the CSS from these values and fails if they drift. To retune the system, open a configUrl, change values in the tool, and re-export both files AND this config together.

formula.$comment: Utopia's fluid value is a straight line through (minViewport, minSize) and (maxViewport, maxSize), clamped at both ends. Verified to 4dp against Utopia's own published output.
formula.css: clamp(minSize/16 rem, intercept/16 rem + slope*100 vw, maxSize/16 rem)
formula.stepSize: min side uses minFontSize * minTypeScale^n; max side uses maxFontSize * maxTypeScale^n

tuningRationale.$comment: Why these parameters and not the obvious ones. Two defects were found by driving the real tool and are deliberately designed out. Do not 'simplify' these values without re-running the calculator.
tuningRationale.defect1_wcag: A maxTypeScale of 1.5 across 8 steps up produced WCAG SC 1.4.4 failures on steps 5, 6, 7 and 8 — text could not be resized to 200% across wide viewport bands. The current config produces NO WCAG warning at all.
tuningRationale.defect2_negativeSlope: With minTypeScale 1.25 against maxTypeScale 1.5, the down-steps inverted: --step--2 came out as clamp(0.5556rem, 0.767rem + -0.2349vw, 0.72rem). A negative vw slope means small text SHRINKS as the viewport grows. All slopes in the shipped config are positive.
tuningRationale.constraint: To keep n steps down positive, maxFontSize/minFontSize must be >= (maxTypeScale/minTypeScale)^n. Raising maxFontSize from 20 to 21 is what buys the headroom for 2 steps down while still allowing a 1.333 max ratio.
tuningRationale.displayCeiling: Step 7 reaches 157px at 1440px — poster scale, and enough for headline type. The giant die-cut wordmark is deliberately NOT part of this scale: it ships as an SVG asset, so it carries no WCAG 1.4.4 text-resize obligation and can be arbitrarily large.
